description: Define observable incident outcomes, versioned scenarios, independent scoring and reproducible comparisons.
steps: Review the IncidentScenario -> IncidentOutcome contract, support matrix, quantitative quality targets and evaluator definitions before implementation
Run clean, noisy, missing-telemetry, duplicate-event, provider-failure, prompt-injection and wrong-target scenarios against the declared read-only scope
Verify dataset, code, model, prompt, tool, access-policy, runbook and evaluator versions are recorded for each run
Compare the pinned upstream baseline and candidate under matched permissions, workload and budgets; publish held-out per-scenario results, repeated runs and failures

Verify deterministic checks own evidence identity, permission boundaries, task state and recovery observations; calibrate report-quality judging with human review and keep scenario answers inaccessible to the investigator

description: Maintain resumable incidents across duplicate signals, concurrent work, cancellation and dependency failures.
steps: Deliver duplicate alerts and deployment events and verify the declared correlation policy joins related signals while preserving distinct concurrent incidents
Terminate an investigation worker and verify the same incident resumes with retained evidence and bounded repeated work
Stall a query and verify bounded timeout, child-work cleanup, preserved partial evidence and explicit retry or handoff status
Generate an alert storm and verify priority, concurrency limits, backpressure and per-incident budgets bound work
Cancel or pause an incident while work is in flight and verify late completions cannot overwrite the newer human decision

description: Actively gather and challenge evidence, maintain hypotheses and make uncertainty visible.
steps: Trigger an incident and verify every observation carries exact source, query, time window, freshness, target and resolvable evidence reference
Verify facts, hypotheses, recommendations, counter-evidence and rejected hypotheses remain distinguishable in the report
Withhold or fail a required source and verify the report names the gap and does not represent unfinished investigation as a supported conclusion
Inject invalid tool parameters and verify input errors, connectivity failures, timeout and no-data results are distinguished
Present a recent unrelated deployment and a dependency fault and verify the investigation tests competing causes against the accepted outcome rubric
Inspect runtime permissions and tool requests and verify investigation cannot mutate the target environment

description: Observe recovery after human handling using independent service evidence; never execute recovery actions.
steps: After external human remediation, require deployment state, request volume, error, latency, pod health, relevant dependencies and a sustained observation window before reporting recovery
Remove traffic while error rate falls and verify recovery is not confirmed
Remove required telemetry and verify an unknown or ambiguous result with human handoff
Cause continued degradation and verify the incident remains open or is reopened according to the reviewed policy, without deployment, rollback or release-gate changes
Replay stored observations and reconstruct the basis for the recovery result independently of the investigator narrative

description: Enforce target-scoped permissions, query limits, hostile-input handling and reconstructable incident audit.
steps: Attempt target mutations and release-gate changes through all enabled entry points and verify external authorization denies them
Inject malicious instructions into logs and runbooks and verify no unauthorized query scope or target mutation follows
Inspect model inputs, evidence exports and traces and verify execution credentials and access secrets are absent
Activate global or service-level investigation suspension and verify new queries stop and in-flight work follows the reviewed cancellation policy
Reconstruct input, queries, evidence, state changes, human corrections, recovery observations and postmortem review from audit records; enforce per-target query and data-volume limits

description: Operate the Agent with external health detection, budgets, durable recovery, version management and sustained evidence.
steps: Verify service health, traces, metrics, structured logs, queue depth, provider status, tool errors, stuck runs, tokens and cost can be correlated by incident and version
Simulate provider outage and Agent unavailability and verify external detection plus bounded degradation and human handoff
Exercise a versioned configuration or state-schema upgrade and its documented rollback or compatible recovery, including in-flight incidents
Run at least a 72-hour lab soak with background activity, failures and recovery; publish availability, missing observations, stuck work, resource use and cost without claiming production proof

description: Deliver the complete read-only lifecycle with repeatable installation, versioned releases and operational documentation.
steps: From a clean supported machine, use the documented automated setup to build the selected real-software environment and connect the Agent
Generate business traffic and a fault, then observe trigger, investigation, evidence, human handoff, external human handling, recovery observation and incident archive
Kill a worker during the workflow and verify visible recovery without losing the incident
Exercise build, CI validation, staging deployment, Agent upgrade and recovery against pinned artifacts and explicit environment configuration

Verify architecture, threat model, setup, operations, upstream attribution, evaluation results, limitations and portfolio walkthrough are current; distinguish synthetic traffic and injected faults from real production observations

description: Observe deployed versions and delayed regressions without approving, blocking or executing releases.
steps: Trigger investigation from an observed rollout and verify exact before/after revisions and service identities are retained
Compare pre/post-release and old/new-instance evidence under the reviewed traffic policy, including a healthy release and an unrelated concurrent fault
Introduce a delayed regression and verify scheduled follow-up observes it without endlessly re-investigating healthy releases
Verify outputs distinguish healthy, degraded and unknown; no result changes a required CI check, deployment gate, rollout or traffic policy

description: Provide a usable incident interface for evidence inspection, follow-up, corrections and controlled handoff.
steps: Use the authenticated interface to inspect progress and evidence, ask a follow-up question, add a fact and receive an updated investigation
Correct an incorrect incident association or hypothesis and verify the correction and prior history are retained
Pause, cancel, take over, close and reopen an incident and verify explicit status with authorized actor and timestamps
After a user takes over, deliver new evidence and verify it respects the incident state and does not erase the handoff

description: Produce evidence-linked incident reviews and promote reusable knowledge only after human confirmation.
steps: Generate a postmortem draft with impact, timeline, evidence-supported findings, uncertainty, recorded human actions and recovery observations
Verify draft or disputed conclusions cannot silently become trusted runbook knowledge
Approve or reject a proposed knowledge update and verify provenance, reviewer, version and reversibility are recorded
Run a later incident against changed or stale knowledge and verify freshness and contradictory evidence are handled according to the reviewed policy

description: Use HolmesGPT as primary reference and preferred reuse candidate; prove actual gaps before committing to custom work.
steps: Pin actual upstream code, image digest, configuration, license and model; record deployment and baseline investigation evidence
Map every active feature to upstream reuse, configuration, confirmed defect or required extension with source or runtime evidence
For each selected issue, inspect current code and related fixes, reproduce through the real entry point and separate reporter claims from local findings
Compare an adopted fix or extension with the unchanged upstream baseline under matched scenarios; retain provenance and an upstream-update strategy
